The Sistan and Baluchestan Police Information Center announced on Wednesday that First Sergeant Mohammad-Ali Shahriari was martyred in the attack on a police vehicle in Mehrestan County.
​
The armed terrorists fled the scene after the attack, and efforts to identify and arrest those responsible are underway.

Mehrestan County is located in Sistan and Baluchestan Province, southeastern Iran.
